adoption_rule.a_complete: all four comparison fits completed in all four senses (training completed, worker exit 0, artifacts persisted, host acknowledgment uploaded), replayed under pmm-v3-replay-1, with verified durable copies; the four 50-epoch controls equal the evidence bound by the launch manifest
adoption_rule.b_interval: both unadjusted 95% lower bounds of S1 above zero: fold bootstrap (percentile, 10,000 resamples, seed 42) and t interval with 3 degrees of freedom
adoption_rule.decision: adopt the 10-epoch schedule for the step F refit only if (a), (b), (c) and (d) all hold; otherwise not adopted, with every failed condition named by class and magnitude

comparison.control: the four verified 50-epoch fits of the selected cell
comparison.estimand: mean over folds 1-4 of the paired common-four balanced-accuracy differences (candidate minus control)
comparison.metric: common-four balanced accuracy at the terminal checkpoint

development_fold.role: reported separately as the development fold; never inside an interval; step-B probes are not reused as evidence or namespace for the gate

excluded: a second assessment of the same fits with changed rules
interpretation: Exploratory and post hoc: the hypothesis came from fold-0 step-B probes that were seen before this comparison was proposed. Folds 1-4 were already used by the A4 and E2 decisions; one training seed (42). Passing the adoption rule does not establish independently confirmed superiority or robustness across training seeds. The 50-epoch controls were selected on these folds, so their values may be optimistic, which works against the candidate. A failed rule is not evidence of no effect. The step F test stays one-shot and both_results_secondary.

outcomes.adopted: adopt the 10-epoch cosine schedule with its terminal checkpoint for the step F refit of the same cell (E_sel = 10); the plan's fixed 50-epoch decision is amended for that refit only, by a dated log entry
outcomes.blocked: a fit failed after its one unchanged rerun: no decision is made; the 50-epoch selection stands unless the user decides otherwise

sensitivity.basis: the 17 declared E2 comparisons plus S1, all on folds 1-4
sensitivity.role: sensitivity evidence only; never a gate

single_change: --epochs 10 instead of 50 (the cosine schedule then spans 10 epochs from the same peak learning rates, and the terminal checkpoint is epoch 10); every other trainer setting, input, fold, class weight, seed, precision and lane setting is that of the 50-epoch controls
stopping_rule: exactly the four listed fits; a failed fit gets one unchanged rerun (same seed and identity)
a second failure blocks the decision
one assessment, after all four fits are verified
whatever the result, the next step is step F; no further pre-step-F experiment follows from this one
